description: Use this when the user asks to stop following a drug, gene, process or other entity on AgingResearch.News. Takes the type and key that list_follows, find_entities or get_entity give. Removes the follow from the user's account.

key.description: The entity's key within its type, such as rapamycin.

type.description: The entity's type, as find_entities or get_entity gives it.

name: unfollow
